title: Which drone delivery use case to focus on
decision: Which US drone delivery use case should a new, software-capable startup focus on in 2026, if any?

options.label: Suburban retail and food last mile
Don't start yet, wait for Part 108

bezos.reason: Which bet to make and how reversible it is

sanchez.reason: Build a fleet or ride someone else's

brief: Pre-revenue founder with some funding, industry access, and software skills wants to enter US drone delivery. Wing with Walmart, Zipline, and Amazon dominate consumer delivery, costs run $15 to $25 per drop, and the FAA's routine-flight rule is still pending. The founder leans toward retail and food.
assumptions: Leans B because it is the biggest market (assumed)
